title: Torn diary page
text:
Day ? — I ran the whole corridor the first time. Nothing happened. I thought the sign was a joke.

The second time something was knocking behind a door when I ran.
I woke up at the start again. The chalk marks were gone.

Walk when it knocks. Run when it doesn't. — R.S., Room 209

title: Note in a child's handwriting
text:
Some things blink at you out of the corner of your eye and are gone.
Those are the building lying. Ignore them.

The things that STAY are the building changing.
Turn back for those.

title: Back of a hotel receipt
text:
Meridian Guest House — Room 2__

The numbers on the walls are not all the numbers.
My phone saw one the walls don't show. Left side. Past the painting of the river.
